faq.q: What have condos in Brighouse, Richmond sold for?

items.t: Brighouse, Richmond: 11 townhomes sold at a median of $794,000, with the middle half between $625,900 and $939,000. The median townhome took 17 days to sell and closed at 95.9% of list.

479 condos sold in Brighouse, Richmond at a median of $620,000 (middle half $503,400 to $739,950). A typical condo in Brighouse, Richmond spent 36 days on the market and closed at 96.2% of the asking price.

blocks.text: Source: Paragon closed sales, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026; medians need 5 or more sales.
How Brighouse compares with the rest of Richmond

items.t: Townhomes in Brighouse have the lowest median of the 22 Richmond sub-areas, $794,000, below Hamilton RI at $837,900; the highest is Woodwards at $1,213,900.

Of 14 Richmond sub-areas with 5 or more condo sales, Brighouse ranks third highest at $620,000; the range is $186,500 (Granville) to $675,000 (Steveston South). Bridgeport RI ($613,000) sits just below and West Cambie ($630,500) sits just above.

blocks.text: By build year, condos are the newest homes selling in Brighouse, Richmond (median 2012) and townhomes the oldest (median 1988), a gap of 24 years.
